description.en: The ID of the resource directory.

description.zh:
新的删除策略。删除RAM用户同步时，对已同步的RAM用户的处理策略。取值：

- Delete：删除。删除RAM用户同步时，会删除从云SSO已经同步到RAM中的RAM用户。
- Keep：保留。删除RAM用户同步时，会保留从云SSO已经同步到RAM中的RAM用户。
description.en:
The new deletion policy. The policy is used to manage synchronized users when you delete the RAM user provisioning. Valid values:

- Delete: When you delete the RAM user provisioning, the system deletes the synchronized users.

- Keep: When you delete the RAM user provisioning, the system retains the synchronized users.

description.zh: 新的RAM用户同步描述信息。
description.en: The new description of the RAM user provisioning.

description.zh:
新的冲突策略。当云SSO用户同步到RAM时，如果RAM中存在同名用户时的处理策略。取值：

- KeepBoth：两者都保留。当云SSO用户被同步到RAM时，如果RAM已经存在同名用户，则对云SSO用户的用户名添加后缀`_sso`后尝试创建该用户名的RAM用户。
- TakeOver：替换。当云SSO用户被同步到RAM时，如果RAM已经存在同名用户，则直接将已经存在的RAM用户替换为云SSO同步用户。
description.en:
The new conflict handling policy. The policy is used when a RAM user has the same username as the CloudSSO user who is synchronized to RAM. Valid values:

- KeepBoth: When a CloudSSO user is synchronized to RAM, if a RAM user who has the same username as the CloudSSO user exists, the system creates a RAM user whose username is the username of the CloudSSO user plus the suffix `_sso`.

- TakeOver: When a CloudSSO user is synchronized to RAM, if a RAM user who has the same username as the CloudSSO user exists, the system replaces the RAM user with the CloudSSO user.
The ID of the RAM user provisioning.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso update-user-provisioning --directory-id d-003qew840000 --user-provisioning-id up-002axzhapcbz6e630000 --new-duplication-strategy KeepBoth --new-deletion-strategy Delete --new-description description00000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudsso UpdateUserProvisioning --region cn-hangzhou --DirectoryId 'd-003qew840000' --NewDescription description00000 --UserProvisioningId 'up-002axzhapcbz6e630000' --NewDeletionStrategy Delete --NewDuplicationStrategy KeepBoth
